notes_for_next_agent: One blocking fix, three small pieces. (1) recommender.ts comparator: sleeping-count ascending, then score desc, then earliest start. (2) Propose the amendment for the R10 ordering V rows (V74/V75 as sketched in review.md) and pin them durably in app.test.ts. (3) Add the missing `expect(violations)` assertion to the generated R10 test at bcca0d92.test.ts:493 with an in-file comment. Everything else is verified and needs no change: grading command 171 pass / 0 fail, reviewer sweep 82/82 over V1-V73 (bun adws/adw_data/sessions/r1nonote/context_handoff/value_sweep.ts), real-Chromium eval confirms V71-V73 and every page-read value, real-browser smoke 14/14 controls, typecheck/oxlint/minified bundle clean, frozen spec sections byte-identical (verified by diff against the committed specs copy), and no amendment is left proposed (A4's ruling re-verified and concurred). Repro for the defect: build the 10-person team in /tmp/r10_probe2.ts or the browser eval /tmp/r10_browser.js — the defect is invisible in 3-4 member preset teams, so test with 5+ members.

blocking: R10 ordering: apps/app/domain/recommender.ts:33-36 sorts candidate slots by score descending only. Make the primary sort key the sleeping count ascending (zero-sleeping slots first), then score descending, then earliest start. Evidence: for a 10-person team (9x Europe/Berlin standard hours + 1x America/New_York sleeping 03:00-11:00) the best everyone-awake slot (15:00Z, compromise 64) is absent from the rendered 'Recommended slots' panel, whose six entries all read '1 sleeping - disruptive (75)' — verified in real Chromium. The n=4 tie (3 working+1 sleeping = 60 = 4 shoulder) also ranks a sleeping slot first via the earliest-start tiebreak. This is the 'hiding that one teammate is being scheduled at 3:00 AM' wrong answer the spec names.

Answer-key gap (propose amendment in revision): the effective spec has no V row for R10's ordering, which is why every green run and sweep missed it. Propose V rows pinning it — suggested: V74 (the 5+-member team above must rank the 15:00Z zero-sleeping slot above every slot with a sleeper despite 64 < 75) and V75 (the n=4 60/60 tie ranks the zero-sleeping slot first) — and add a durable test in apps/app/app.test.ts for them.

Executable-suite hole: the generated test 'R10: slots with no sleeping member rank above every slot that has one, and ties rank by score' (apps/app/tests/generated/bcca0d92.test.ts:493-510) builds a violations array but never asserts it is empty, so the suite passes while the rule is unmet. Add the assertion (with an in-file comment, per the A2 precedent).
